P22-14.name: Victory Bladra
P22-14.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Blade Contract, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents)
Return two Cost 3 or less Red-only Spirit cards from your Trash to the Hand.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Draw a card.

P22-03.name: Mugendra-Trinity
P22-03.effect:
This card/Spirit's symbols and reduction symbols are also treated as Yellow/Blue.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Main Step)
Once per turn, your counter can +1. When you've done so, during this turn, an "Incarnate" family Spirit you control is treated as being one LV higher.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Your counter +1, and you draw a card.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11472.name: The MoonlightMusha Heike-Boruta
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11472.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
The cores on your "Moonlight"-named Spirits can't be removed by opposing Spirit/Brave/Magic effects.

[When Braved] [LV2]
When cores are removed from your Spirits due to opposing Spirit/Brave/Magic effects, for each core removed, send a core from any opposing Spirits to the Void.
